name: Choco
source:
A tiny fairy suddenly appeared in the main character's room. She is a self-proclaimed “love cupid” who has come to make the main character's love come true.

It seems that by making the protagonist's love come true, she can become a human being. Though she may be annoying, she can be a good partner for him.

Whatever the case may be, to simply put it, she's just a mysterious fairy.

[From [url=https://palette.clearrave.co.jp/product/kimikoi/chara.htm]official site[/url]]
